summary: Materialized an isolated gh-pages Jose V11 candidate preview that is pinned to the exact durable source Git blob and cannot expose V11 until gzip decode yields exactly 69,235 bytes and WebCrypto SHA-256 equals the recorded V11 digest. Static re-read confirms the gate and candidate/not-current labels. Durable regression evidence records the jose-algebra Catalog baseline plus R06 authority/identity boundaries and R07 eraser/undo negative knowledge. Representative JavaScript browser execution and public Pages propagation were not available in this worker context, so runtime verification is deliberately not claimed.
